issue.title: Match score returns 0 for candidates with no uploads
issue.body:
The scorer short-circuits when a candidate has no uploads and we end up writing a literal 0 instead of skipping the row.

Relevant code:

- https://github.com/my-org/primary-app/blob/main/src/services/MatchScoreService.ts#L118-L146
- `src/lib/matchScore/messageBuilder.ts:88`
- packages/api/src/scoring/normalize.mjs

Stack trace from production:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'tags')
    at buildProfile (src/lib/matchScore/profile.ts:212:18)
    at scoreCandidate (src/services/MatchScoreService.ts:131:22)
```

Related to #7 and my-org/infra-tools#215. Regression landed in a1b2c3d4e5f67890.

- [x] Reproduce with a fixture candidate
- [ ] Skip instead of writing 0
- [ ] Backfill the affected rows
